activities.label: Activities
activities.tooltip: Filter which Insight Timer activities are included in every chart. Click to toggle, or use Select All / Deselect All.

presets.label: Presets
presets.tooltip: Filter which Insight Timer presets are included in every chart. Click to toggle, or use Select All / Deselect All.

unit.label: Unit
unit.tooltip: The measurement shown on every chart's Y-axis and tooltip: minutes, hours, or raw session count.

dateFrom.label: From
dateFrom.tooltip: Start of the global date range. Sessions before this date are excluded.

dateTo.label: To
dateTo.tooltip: End of the global date range. Sessions after this date are excluded.

timeWindow.label: Time Window
timeWindow.tooltip: Quick presets for the visible date range: Last 3 Months, Last 6 Months, Last Year, Year to Date, All Time, or a Custom Range.

timelineFrom.label: From
timelineFrom.tooltip: Start date for the custom time window.

timelineTo.label: To
timelineTo.tooltip: End date for the custom time window.

granularity.label: Aggregate By
granularity.tooltip: How sessions are grouped along the time axis: day, week, month, quarter, season, or year.

splitBy.label: Time Split
splitBy.tooltip: Split the timeline into separate colored series, one per time period (week, month, quarter, season, or year).

movingAverage.label: Moving Average
movingAverage.tooltip: Smooths the line by averaging each point with its neighbors over N days. Set to 0 to disable.

statisticalOverlays.label: Statistical Overlays
statisticalOverlays.tooltip: Add a mean line, a shaded ±1 standard deviation band, or a linear trendline to the timeline.

comparisonStrategy.label: Comparison Strategy
comparisonStrategy.tooltip: Overlay multiple periods on one chart (relative), or lay them out side-by-side as separate charts (grid).

lockYAxis.label: Lock Y-Axis Scale
lockYAxis.tooltip: Use one shared Y-axis scale across all compared periods so bars and lines are visually comparable.

xAxisAlignment.label: X-Axis Alignment
xAxisAlignment.tooltip: Align periods by calendar date, or by elapsed days from each period's first data point (Day 1).

comparisonFrom.label: From
comparisonFrom.tooltip: Start date of the new comparison period.

comparisonTo.label: To
comparisonTo.tooltip: End date of the new comparison period.

comparisonColor.label: Color
comparisonColor.tooltip: The line/bar color used for this comparison period.

category.label: Category
category.tooltip: Which breakdown to visualize: Day-of-Week, Time-of-Day, or Activity & Preset.

chartStyle.label: Chart Style
chartStyle.tooltip: The visualization type for the selected category, e.g. heatmap matrix, polar clock, donut, or stacked bar.

breakdownMode.label: Breakdown By
breakdownMode.tooltip: Split the breakdown by activity or by preset.

temporalGrouping.label: Temporal Grouping
temporalGrouping.tooltip: Group distribution values by week, month, quarter, season, or year.

metric.label: Metric
metric.tooltip: The value being measured: total duration, session count, or average session length.

threshold.label: Threshold Filter
threshold.tooltip: Ignore sessions shorter than this many minutes when computing distributions.
